traits.wood_modulus_green_mpa.note: Wood Handbook 2021 (FPL-GTR-282), table 5-3a, green: the range of the 5 Fraxinus species it tests (black, blue, green, Oregon, white), median typical. A species with its own row states its own.

traits.wood_rupture_green_mpa.note: Wood Handbook 2021 (FPL-GTR-282), table 5-3a, green modulus of rupture: the range of the 5 Fraxinus species it tests (black, blue, green, Oregon, white), median typical. A species with its own row states its own.

traits.wood_moisture_green_share.note: Wood Handbook 2021 (FPL-GTR-282), table 4-1: average moisture of green heartwood and sapwood of the Fraxinus species it lists (black, green, white), as shares of oven-dry mass; the range, median typical.

traits.flowering_position.note: The Woody Plant Seed Manual's Fraxinus chapter (read in full): ash flowers appear with or before the leaves in terminal or axillary panicles.

traits.leaf_division.note: Wikipedia Fraxinus (read 2026-10-17): leaves opposite, occasionally whorled, and mostly pinnate, implying a few exceptions (single-blade ashes), unnamed there.

traits.fruit_type.note: Wikipedia Fraxinus (read 2026-10-17): fruit a single-winged samara, the familiar ash keys; about 45 to 65 species.
